There are three conditions that must be fulfilled before you can become a Merchant.
First, You have to be a Novice with Job Level 10, and have learned all of the Basic Skills.
Second, You have to pay a 1,000 Zeny Membership Fee. I believe any Merchant candidate should be able to earn 1,000 Zeny with ease.
Third, there is a License Test to test your physical strength and sense of direction. You will deliver a package to a specific person in a specific location.
